newsitem.title: UK: Lower gold price, charge hit Ashanti profit.
newsitem.headline: Lower gold price, charge hit Ashanti profit.

text.p: Ghana's Ashanti Goldfields Co. Ltd Tuesday reported a 42.5 percent fall in second quarter earnings, which were hit by an exceptional charge and a lower gold price.
But the company, West Africa's largest gold miner, said it was on track to meet 1997 production and cost forecasts.
Earnings fell to $7.7 million after a $2.5 million charge for redundancy costs, which compared with earnings of $13.4 million a year ago.
Ashanti realised a gold price of $450 an ounce, down from $465 in the second quarter of 1996.
